adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when sync mode is enabled it validates against `minimumTokenResponseSchema` (which does not require `refresh_token`) and then forcibly sets `refresh_token` to the literal string "refresh_token" if missing. In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token data is merged into the existing credentials via `{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`, which will overwrite the previously stored real `refresh_token` with that placeholder string. This is a verifiable data-loss defect introduced by the diff.
